title: The People Who Refuse to Repent

questions.question: "At that time, declares the Lord, the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be brought out of their..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:1 (ESV): "shall be brought out of their tombs."

questions.question: "And they shall be spread before the sun and the moon and all the... of heaven, which they have loved and served, which they have gone after,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:2 (ESV): "before the sun and the moon and all the host of heaven,"

questions.question: What did the Lord say the scattered bones would become on the surface of the ground?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:2 (ESV): "they shall not be gathered or buried. They shall be as dung on the surface of the ground."

questions.question: "...death shall be preferred to... by all the remnant that remains of this evil family in all the places where I have driven them,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:3 (ESV): "death shall be preferred to life by all the remnant that remains of this evil family"

questions.question: "When men fall, do they not rise again? If one turns away, does he not return? Why then has this people, Jerusalem, turned away in perpetual...?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:4-5 (ESV): "Why then has this people, Jerusalem, turned away in perpetual backsliding?"

questions.question: "Even the... in the heavens knows her times, and the turtledove, swallow, and crane keep the time of their coming, but my people know not the rules of the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:7 (ESV): "Even the stork in the heavens knows her times,"

questions.question: "How can you say, 'We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us'? But behold, the lying pen of the... has made it into a lie."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:8 (ESV): "But behold, the lying pen of the scribes has made it into a lie."

questions.question: "The wise men shall be put to shame; they shall be dismayed and taken; behold, they have rejected the word of the Lord, so what... is in them?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:9 (ESV): "so what wisdom is in them?"

questions.question: Jeremiah repeated a phrase from Chapter 6: "They have healed the wound of my people lightly, saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:11 (ESV): "saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace." (Repeated from 6:14)

questions.question: "Were they ashamed when they committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed; they did not know how to..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:12 (ESV): "they did not know how to blush." (Repeated from 6:15)

questions.question: "Why do we sit still? Gather together, let us go into the fortified cities and perish there, for the Lord our God has doomed us to perish and has given us poisoned... to drink,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:14 (ESV): "and has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the Lord."

questions.question: "We looked for peace, but no good came; for a time of healing, but behold, ...!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:15 (ESV): "We looked for peace, but no good came; for a time of healing, but behold, terror!"

questions.question: "The snorting of their horses is heard from...; at the sound of the neighing of their stallions the whole land quakes." (Referring to the arriving enemy from the north)
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:16 (ESV): "The snorting of their horses is heard from Dan;"

questions.question: "For behold, I am sending among you serpents, adders that cannot be..., and they shall bite you, declares the Lord."
"Is there no balm in...? Is there no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 8:22 (ESV): "Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there?"

key_verse_text: "Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?"
